# GIMP

> GIMP is a free, cross-platform GNU image editor for photo manipulation, graphic design, and digital art creation.

GIMP (GNU Image Manipulation Program) is an open-source image editor available for Linux, macOS, and Windows. The site provides downloads, documentation, community tutorials, and development resources for both users and contributors.

## Key Topics

- GNU Image Manipulation Program
- open-source
- free-software
- image-editing
- photo-manipulation

## Getting Started

- [GIMP - GNU Image Manipulation Program](https://www.gimp.org): GIMP homepage introducing the free cross-platform image editor
- [GIMP - Downloads](https://www.gimp.org/downloads): Download GIMP 3.2.0 for Linux, macOS, Windows, and Flatpak
- [GIMP - About GIMP](https://www.gimp.org/about): About GIMP: free GNU software for image manipulation and design
- [GIMP - Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.gimp.org/docs/userfaq.html): GIMP FAQ covering features, licensing, and troubleshooting

## Documentation & Learning

- [GIMP - Documentation](https://www.gimp.org/docs): GIMP user manual, help system, and getting-started tutorials
- [GIMP - Community Tutorials](https://www.gimp.org/tutorials): Community-created tutorials for image editing and painting
- [GIMP - Recent Books About GIMP](https://www.gimp.org/books): Published books about GIMP in multiple languages

## Community & Support

- [GIMP - Discuss](https://www.gimp.org/discuss.html): GIMP community discussion forums, IRC, Discord, and social
- [GIMP - Bugs](https://www.gimp.org/bugs): Bug reporting and tracking via GNOME GitLab
- [GIMP - Get Involved](https://www.gimp.org/develop): Contribute to GIMP: development, bug reporting, translation
- [GIMP - Donate](https://www.gimp.org/donating): Support GIMP development via Patreon, Liberapay, GNOME
- [GIMP - Contacting the Webmasters](https://www.gimp.org/webmasters.html): Contact webmasters for website issues and bug reporting

## News & Development

- [GIMP - News](https://www.gimp.org/news): GIMP news, releases, and announcements from the GIMP Team
- [Roadmaps – GIMP Developer](https://developer.gimp.org/core/roadmap): GIMP development roadmap with feature priorities for v3.4

## Optional

- [GIMP - GIMP 3.2 Release Notes](https://www.gimp.org/release-notes/gimp-3.2.html): GIMP 3.2 release notes with new features and improvements
- [GIMP - GIMP Release Notes](https://www.gimp.org/release-notes): GIMP version history and release notes archive
